partners.mechanism_chain: FGF23 (HGNC:3567) —DISRUPTS→ Phosphate and Vitamin D Metabolism; Phosphate and Vitamin D Metabolism —LEADS_TO→ Hypophosphatemia (HP:0002149); PDGFRB (HGNC:9407) —DISRUPTS→ PDGFRB signaling pathway; PDGFRB signaling pathway —INCREASES→ Abnormal connective tissue proliferation (HP:0003198); Abnormal connective tissue proliferation (HP:0003198) —LEADS_TO→ Ocular pterygium (HP:0000575); Abnormal connective tissue proliferation (HP:0003198) —LEADS_TO→ Digital keloid (HP:0030106).
